ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/tan) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central high-intensity white field; horizontal tan-colored band across the mid-section of both lobes; contiguous black perimeter border along leading and trailing edges; localized black mottling at the median notch vertex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth of 85 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular peak amplitudes (5-15 pixels) across the continuous trailing edge span, isolated from the gray-scale water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal termini.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of dark, textured, roughly circular pixel groups localized at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered dark punctate marks within the white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Primary vertical linear mark on left lobe; primary diagonal linear mark on right lobe; multiple smaller horizontal streaks within the tan-colored band.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular trailing edge notches near distal tips; heavy colonization by high-relief, dark textured clusters on the outer margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced horizontal bi-tonal pigmentation consisting of a yellowish-tan band across the primary white ventral surface.
